answer: Each agent identity must lease a night-market stall lit by a lantern and keep a signed sales ledger audited nightly; a raven courier carries the ledger to the market clerk, who checks every sale against the stall's pulse of daily trade. The first stall costs $25, and each extra identity's stall costs double the last, so ten fake stalls cost $25,575 - far more than any profit a sybil swarm could skim.
